verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The comment now correctly distinguishes ordinary Git behavior for tracked files from release-plz's explicit rejection of committed-and-ignored paths. The cited release-plz.toml note contains the quoted failure, documents allow_dirty = true, and identifies the same tracked-and-ignored mechanism. The two named regression seed files are tracked, the claimed count of 27 property-test sources matches the repository, and the per-test failure_persistence opt-out precedent exists. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in this documentation-only change.
